close_reason: hackney 1.25.0 -> 4.7.4 via ex_aws 2.7.0 (constraint relaxed to ~> 4.0), clearing CVE-2026-47069/-47071/-47075/-47076 (all fixed in hackney 4.0.1). Added Bedrock.ObjectStorage.S3.HttpClient to fix ex_aws 2.7's bundled adapter crashing on bodiless HEAD responses (caught by 4 red CAS tests against real MinIO). Added mix_audit dev dep + CI 'mix deps.audit' step (one matrix cell) so future advisories fail the build. deps.audit now clean. Deferred upstream: minio_server 0.4.0 caps the test-only MinIO binary at RELEASE.2024-09-13 (21 advisories; 127.0.0.1, test-run lifetime only) — its bundled version list rejects newer releases. PR #142.
description: OSV audit of mix.lock found hackney 1.25.0 carries CVE-2026-47069 (CRLF injection via cookie domain/path), CVE-2026-47071 (SOCKS5 TLS upgrade ignores caller timeout), CVE-2026-47075 (CR/LF injection in query parameter), CVE-2026-47076 (SSRF allowlist bypass via percent-encoded host) — all fixed in hackney 4.0.1. ex_aws 2.6.1 constrained hackney ~> 1.16; ex_aws 2.7.0 requires ~> 4.0. Bump ex_aws to ~> 2.7 and hackney to ~> 4.0. Add mix_audit dev dep + CI step so advisories surface automatically. Also refresh the pinned MinIO test binary (RELEASE.2024-09-13 has 21 known advisories; dev/test only).

comments.text: Reworked per review question: hackney dropped entirely instead of upgraded. Object storage now uses Req 0.7 via ExAws.Request.Req (injected per request in the S3 backend; test support's Minio.config too). The HEAD shim and hackney's nine-package transitive tree are deleted. Same verification bar: full suite vs real MinIO over Req green, deps.audit clean, dialyzer both envs.

title: Fix hackney CVEs via ex_aws 2.7 / hackney 4.x; add dependency audit to CI
